correctness.rationale: Fourier orthogonality proves smoothness and reduces a specific tangent-incidence fibre to four exact quadrics in P^3. Exact Groebner bases certify that the fibre is one reduced point, and a finite-module argument then forces generic tangent degree one.

originality.rationale: Kanazawa proves tangent birationality for a general intersection of four quadrics, but targeted literature and SCOPE searches found no certification of this explicit Fourier-diagonal special member or an equivalent reduced-fibre calculation.

value.rationale: The theorem supplies a concrete highly symmetric special member satisfying a newly stated tangent-birationality conjecture, together with a compact exact certificate reusable for other special complete intersections.
